search_semantics.drug: Matches the intervention name or derived intervention MeSH term: filter.advanced (AREA[InterventionName]"<drug>" OR AREA[InterventionMeshTerm]"<drug>") matches the listed intervention names (with the API's concept expansion of aliases) or the study-level intervention MeSH terms, not titles or descriptions. Trials whose intervention is a class placeholder (e.g. 'PD-1 inhibitor') listing the drug as an other name are included, and so are MeSH mis-mappings.

assumptions: The plan was drafted from the question by the LLM (gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 via openai) and validated; meta.interpretation.draft holds the draft. Counts come from the registry.
Served from the local cache stored at 2026-10-18 19:05 UTC.

Drug nodes are intervention MeSH terms filed under Chemicals and Drugs: supplementary concepts (ids starting with C) and descriptors with a MeSH tree number in branch D (NLM MeSH 2025 trees); non-drug interventions such as radiotherapy (E02), procedures and diagnostics are not drug nodes.

Node type 'drug' marks an intervention MeSH term: the API does not link MeSH terms to intervention types (DRUG, RADIATION, PROCEDURE, ...), so drug nodes are chosen by MeSH tree branch instead of by intervention type.

117 intervention MeSH terms outside the Chemicals and Drugs branch, or comparators without active treatment, are not drawn as nodes; most frequent: Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy (D009682, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 84 trials; Specimen Handling (D013048, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 81 trials; Radiotherapy (D011878, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 79 trials; Biopsy (D001706, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 50 trials; Taxes (D013660, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 49 trials; Radiation (D011827, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 47 trials; Drug Therapy (D004358, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 43 trials; Radiosurgery (D016634, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 42 trials; Surgical Procedures, Operative (D013514, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 30 trials; Radiotherapy, Intensity-Modulated (D050397, not_in_chemicals_and_drugs_branch): 18 trials. 456 trials affected; their other values are kept. Full list in meta.network.excluded_terms.

16 nodes (0 shown) have type drug_class: their MeSH tree numbers are all in D26 (Pharmaceutical Preparations) or D27 (Chemical Actions and Uses), so they name a drug class or dosage form, not a specific drug. Most frequent: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors (D000082082): 24 trials; Adjuvants, Pharmaceutic (D000277): 5 trials; Solutions (D012996): 4 trials; Histamine H2 Antagonists (D006635): 3 trials; Adjuvants, Immunologic (D000276): 2 trials; Drugs, Generic (D016568): 2 trials; Histamine Antagonists (D006633): 2 trials; Pharmaceutical Preparations (D004364): 2 trials; Anti-Bacterial Agents (D000900): 1 trial; Antimetabolites (D000963): 1 trial.
Node size is the number of trials an entity appears in; a trial counts toward every entity it lists, so node sizes can add up to more than the number of trials.
warnings: 914 of 2642 trials have fewer than two distinct values of intervention MeSH term and contribute no edges.

Network trimmed for readability: showing 50 of 595 nodes (highest weighted degree, cap MAX_NETWORK_NODES=50) and 650 of 6463 edges; 4663 edges below MIN_EDGE_WEIGHT=2 trials and 1150 edges to omitted nodes are not shown. 570 trials with co-occurrences contribute no shown edge, and 8 trials appear in no shown node. Node sizes still count every trial.

The network response was 1.6 MB, over the 1.0 MB budget (NETWORK_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES), so citations per edge were cut to 2 (NETWORK_REDUCED_EDGE_CITATION_CAP); no edge was dropped and each edge's citation_count_total keeps the true number. Size now 0.57 MB.
